# GENERATED FILE - CK3 1.21.0.3 native GUI with MTS scrollable tenet grids
on_rite_updated = {
	events = {
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { mts_selector_only_metadata_update_trigger = yes }
			}

			root = {
				save_scope_as = rite
			}
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = merchants_tally
				limit = {
					holder ?= {
						rite = scope:rite
					}
				}
				holder = {
					gdp_update_usury_reputation_effect = yes
				}
			}

			if = { # slient it for EC since EC has unique event to inform
				limit = {
					exists = scope:changed_tenets_or_doctrines
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							faith = { has_variable = ecumenical_council_ongoing }
						}
						exists = scope:consume_rite_edit_token
					}
				}

				# The message icon slot must never be left unset, hence the fall-through to the rite itself
				if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = added_tenets count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = added_tenets
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = added_doctrines count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = added_doctrines
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = removed_tenets count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = removed_tenets
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = removed_doctrines count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = removed_doctrines
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = changed_tenet_status count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = changed_tenet_status
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else = {
					root = { save_scope_as = rite_change_icon }
				}

				every_player = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							rite = root
							AND = {
								faith = root.faith
								root.faith.main_rite = root
							}
						}
					}
					send_interface_message = {
						type = msg_rite_updated
						title = msg_rite_updated
						left_icon = scope:rite_change_icon

						show_as_tooltip = {
							every_in_list = {
								list = removed_doctrines
								root = { remove_rite_doctrine = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = added_doctrines
								root = { add_rite_doctrine = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = removed_tenets
								root = { remove_rite_tenet = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = added_tenets
								root = { add_rite_tenet = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = changed_tenet_status
								save_temporary_scope_as = tenet
								root = {
									if = {
										limit = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = permitted } }
										faith = { set_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = permitted } }
									}
									else_if = {
										limit = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = prohibited } }
										faith = { set_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = prohibited } }
									}
									else_if = {
										limit = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = known } }
										faith = { set_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = known } }
									}
									else_if = {
										limit = { has_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = unknown } }
										faith = { set_tenet_status = { tenet = scope:tenet status = unknown } }
									}
								}
							}
							pam_personal_tenet_rite_update_fulfillment_effect = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}

			head_of_rite ?= {
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0004 # Update HoF succession law
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0001 # Temporal rel head setup
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0002 # Spiritual rel head setup
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0011 # Restore Temporal rel head
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0012 # Restore Spiritual rel head
				trigger_event = faith_creation.1100 # Destroy HoF title if no longer valid

				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:changed_tenets_or_doctrines
						exists = scope:consume_rite_edit_token
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = has_edited_a_rite
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
